correction: The earlier claim that the descriptor at file 0x79ed identifies the class 6 resource at file 0x38a0 was unsupported. 0x38a0 is also an in-segment word pointer, and the indirect callee is parser-like; identical numeric values are not evidence of the same address space or purpose.
evidence: At 0x642a startup computes CS + (0x43d0 >> 4) and stores it in the segment word at 0x377c.
Under the same MZ image mapping used for the descriptor, the far pointer offset at 0x377a is 0x7004, giving candidate file entry 0x4150 + 0x43d0 + 0x7004 = 0xf524.

At 0xf524, a near call reaches 0xea12 and returns far. The candidate callee scans command characters and accesses ES:[DI] as a control block, consistent with the SYSPARSE calling pattern in the baseline.
The word at the descriptor start is 0x38a0, which under the load-image mapping points to nearby in-memory data at file 0x79f0, rather than independently proving a resource file offset.
limits: The full segment assumptions and all control-block fields still need runtime-independent verification.
The class 6 resource and its 2213-byte matched trial remain valid; only the claimed caller/descriptor relationship is withdrawn.
